name: poll360
description: Poll360 — parallel vote tabulation and results broadcast infrastructure. From the booth to the broadcast.

scripts._comment:dev:secure: The microphone. Browsers only hand one over on https or on localhost, so opening the dev server at its network address, to reach it from a phone or a second machine, silently loses Poll360 AI's ability to listen. This serves the same app over https with a self-signed certificate: the browser will warn once about the certificate, and after that the microphone works from any device on the network.
scripts._comment:test: node's own runner, so there is no test dependency to install, keep current or audit. That matters more than usual for software that has to build on somebody else's machine on the morning of an election.
scripts._comment:build:constituencies: The 109 senatorial districts and 360 federal constituencies, joined to the 774 local governments we draw. Run after editing scripts/sources/nigeria-lga-districts.sql or the alias table; it refuses to write anything unless every local government lands in exactly one senatorial district.
scripts._comment:db:indexes: Builds the performance indexes without locking the tables. Run it against a live database BEFORE deploying: the statements in lib/db.js then find them already there and the deploy stays quick. --check says what is missing and builds nothing.
scripts._comment:project:clear: Returns a project to a clean slate: every return, situation report, booth movement and machine reading filed into it. Counts and changes nothing without --commit. Use it to take a rehearsal's test traffic off a live project before the night.
scripts._comment:seed:adamawa: One state, four campaigns. Creates the Adamawa project, loads the declared figures lib/adamawa.js holds, and issues four accounts pinned to a governorship, a senatorial district, a federal constituency and a local government. Prints their passwords once. Runs a dry run without --commit.
scripts._comment:bytes:move: Moves the photographs and the already-delivered bodies into the second database (SECOND_DATABASE_URL), which is space beside the working one rather than a replacement for it. Counts and moves nothing without --commit, reads every row back out of the second database before clearing it from the first, and is safe to run twice.
scripts._comment:databank:replay: Sends Data Bank everything a bad night stopped from landing. Safe to run twice — the hub dedupes on the external id every row carries, so a repeat is recorded once.
scripts._comment:units: Fetches INEC every ward and polling unit in Nigeria into public/geo/units/, one file per state, and refuses to write if the totals drift from the commission published 774 / 8,809 / 176,846.
scripts._comment:agents:move: Moves the agents this product held onto Data Bank’s agent list and issues codes to the approved ones. A dry run without --commit; with it, --out names the file the codes are written to, once.
